package.name: omni_sim
package.description: omni-robot (design.md 28, 30), PC only, never built on the robot: the MuJoCo sim as a ROS 2 robot (bridge, MuJoCo viewer, Foxglove markers), scoring against ground truth, Nav2 goal runs, and the Windows joystick relay. v11: the bridges run the robot's C++ firmware in the loop and expose its USB port over TCP (mcu_port); the catch bridge adds the thrower, the cameras' frames and the catch scorer. The sim itself lives in simulation/ (the version is set by ros/omni.sh).
